description: Composition contract vectors (docs/RFC-001-A2A-Identity-Composition-Contract.md §7). `sign`: both SDKs must sign `card` as `keyId` with the TEST-ONLY seed of that key and produce `signedCard` byte for byte. `cards`: run the format check, then the Ed25519 check of every signature with the key of its kid (`keys`); expect `ok` (with `did` and `publishedKeyIds`), `format_drift` or `tampered`. `documents`: whether the document guard accepts each document. `reasons`: the contract reason for a key whose signature did not verify, read from `document`. Generated by scripts/regenerate-composition-contract-vectors.js.

cards.name: signed by key-1, extension publishes key-1 and key-2
no Agent-DID extension: the signature kid is the only published key
protected header that is not in JCS form
kid is a DID without fragment
protected header is a JSON list
extra member in a signature entry
unprotected header is not an object
Agent-DID extension lists a key of another DID

documents.name: revoked key with the inline term last
revoked key without the inline term
inline term without a revoked key
inline term with an extra member

scenarios.F1: accept: current key, valid card, valid request. SDK tests (CompositionContract / test_composition_contract) and the `cards` ok cases.
scenarios.F2: accept: prior key still listed during a planned overlap. SDK tests; in Agent-DID the overlap is both keys listed in the DID document.
scenarios.F3: reject card_keyid_mismatch: the request keyid is not a key the card publishes. SDK tests; published keys are the `cards` publishedKeyIds.
scenarios.F4: reject rotation_window_closed: `reasons` F4 and SDK tests.
scenarios.F5: reject emergency_revoked: `reasons` F5, `documents` and SDK tests.
scenarios.F6: reject key_purpose_violation: `reasons` F6 and SDK tests.
scenarios.F7: not emitted: the Agent-DID SDKs fail closed with did_document_unresolvable for a DID they cannot resolve; the caller policy decides (contract §4.1 3e as amended).
